concepts.name: Frosted silver
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: High fidelity visual design concept for the native macOS app Tebo.
Input images: Image 1 is the user's original composition and polish reference. Image 2 is the exact supplied Tebo logo, a black rounded square with a sculpted white ribbon T and two white sparkles; preserve this logo faithfully, use it small beside the app name and once at medium size in the right panel. It is a supporting brand insert, not a new logo to design.
Primary request: Generate ONE beautiful, realistic, shippable macOS application screenshot that develops this reference into a less bland, more carefully art-directed interface. Straight-on flat screenshot, no perspective or laptop device, landscape 3:2 composition. Entire app window visible, app fills almost all the frame with a narrow desktop margin, native red yellow green traffic lights, refined rounded window corners. Crisp, legible system typography. Carefully designed hierarchy and spacing, restrained visual detail, real material depth, immaculate alignment. Avoid a generic dashboard template.
Keep the familiar three-column structure: slim left navigation sidebar about 21%, central primary workspace about 56%, slim right brand/activity panel about 23%. Main content must all fit without a scrollbar. Sidebar brand "Tebo", segmented switch labeled exactly "File cleanup" and "image cleanup" above navigation. Selected item "Overview". Other navigation labels exactly "Clean", "Uninstall", "Optimize", "Analyze", "Status", "Project Cleanup"; then a separator, "History", "Settings", bottom status "Ready". Use relevant simple native line icons (home, trash, app, sliders, pie chart, activity, hammer, history, settings), consistent stroke weight.
Center: small eyebrow "A CLEANER MAC, A CLEARER MIND"; headline over two lines "Free up space, keep" / "your Mac running smoothly." Below a beautifully composed scan summary with a refined circular scan symbol, text "Ready to scan" and "Find a little more breathing room.", a prominent pill action labeled "Scan Mac" with an arrow. Below, one cohesive pale or dark list surface containing six equal-height tool rows, clean dividers, colored semantic icons, names and short descriptions. Exact row copy:
"Clean" / "Caches, leftovers and installers" / "Not scanned"
"Uninstall" / "Apps and their related files" / "Browse apps"
"Optimize" / "Refresh caches and maintain your Mac" / "Review tasks"
"Analyze" / "Explore folders and disk usage" / "Not scanned"
"Status" / "Live CPU, memory and system activity" / "View status"
"Project Cleanup" / "Rebuildable outputs and dependencies" / "Not scanned"
Right panel: small search field "Search categories…", supplied logo with restrained material halo, "Tebo", tagline "Clean. Organize. Breathe.", divider, three compact activity rows "Space Freed" with "0 MB", "Files Removed" with "0", "Scan Time" with "–". A small atmospheric finish near the bottom with the words "Less clutter, more focus." Keep the logo panel balanced and modest.
Constraints: spell Tebo T-e-b-o exactly. All labels legible and correctly spelled. Do not copy invented scan sizes from the reference, do not add charts, extra cards, notices, marketing copy, concept labels, captions, or decorative objects. No separate Installers or Purge feature. Do not redraw or replace supplied logo. No watermarks. This image is a visual proposal, not live scan data.
Design direction: FROSTED SILVER. Contemporary bright native Mac interface with milky white glass, softly translucent cool silver sidebar, porcelain-white elevated central cards, near-black graphite typography, one rich electric cobalt blue accent for selected navigation, primary action, and scan ring. Subtle ice-blue refracted light around the right logo, fine silver separators, realistic frosted material and tiny soft ambient shadows. Minimal glass treatment limited to chrome and sidebar; central data stays clear and opaque. Scannable content, striking crisp contrast, bright airy daylight, restrained layered depth. Desktop margin is a very softly blurred cool gray and pale-blue wallpaper. Make this feel meticulously finished and tactile, not flat white HTML boxes.

Design direction: MIDNIGHT BLUE. A complete premium dark native Mac interface with ink navy and black-blue glass chrome, deep slate content surfaces, luminous porcelain typography, a confident glacier-cyan primary button and fine cyan selected-state highlight. Very subtle blue-violet atmospheric spill behind the logo, sophisticated smoky translucency, carefully bounded low-luminance surfaces and soft reflections. No bright neon strips or gaming aesthetic. Balanced local light: scan summary slightly lighter than canvas, tools on a coherent deeper surface, readable muted slate descriptions. Semantic category icon accents in subdued cyan, periwinkle, amber. Desktop margin is blurred dark blue twilight. All three columns share this elegant dark appearance, not just a dark sidebar. Make the supplied black logo visible through a subtle light halo without changing the mark.

Design direction: WARM PORCELAIN. Refined editorial macOS utility with warm ivory canvas, creamy pearl-white card surfaces, pale mushroom translucent sidebar, dark espresso/charcoal text, and a rich burnt-coral/terracotta primary action and selected-state accent. Keep this warm yet crisp and contemporary, not washed-out beige or retro. The scan summary has a very faint warm peach wash and one decisive coral scan ring; muted aubergine, sage and steel-blue semantic icons retain functional meaning. Surface separation comes from white cards and exquisite thin borders, subtle light shadows and carefully controlled warmth. Right logo rests in a pearlescent warm-white halo with tiny champagne highlights; quiet soft sculpted waves near the bottom reference the original. Desktop margin softly blurred stone and peach daylight. Strong editorial typography, substantial clean spacing, no huge blank areas, no additional widgets.
